module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.OpenSubgroup
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.Preorder

/-!
# Preimages of open normal subgroups

A continuous homomorphism pulls an open normal subgroup back to an open
normal subgroup. This file packages that construction, its membership,
monotonicity, identity, and source-first composition laws, and the induced
change-of-index functor between the opposite open-normal posets.

Source, target, and intermediate group universes are independent. Only the
group structures, topologies, and bundled continuity of the homomorphisms are
used; no IsTopologicalGroup, compactness, or surjectivity assumption is
required.

## Main declarations

* OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
* OpenNormalSubgroup.mem_comap
* OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_mono
* OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_id
* OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_comp
* ContinuousCohomology.openNormalComapFunctor
* ContinuousCohomology.openNormalComapFunctor_id
* ContinuousCohomology.openNormalComapFunctor_comp
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory

universe u v w

namespace OpenNormalSubgroup

/-- Preimage of an open normal subgroup under a continuous homomorphism. -/
def comap
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    OpenNormalSubgroup H where
  toOpenSubgroup := U.toOpenSubgroup.comap phi.toMonoidHom phi.continuous
  isNormal' := U.isNormal'.comap phi.toMonoidHom

/-- Membership in an open-normal preimage is literal preimage membership. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_comap
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (h : H) :
    h ∈ comap phi U ↔ phi h ∈ U :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Open-normal preimage is monotone in the subgroup. -/
theorem comap_mono
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) {U V : OpenNormalSubgroup G} (hUV : U ≤ V) :
    comap phi U ≤ comap phi V := fun _ h => hUV h

/-- Preimage under the identity homomorphism is the original subgroup. -/
@[simp]
theorem comap_id
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    comap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) U = U := by
  ext g
  rfl

/-- Open-normal preimages compose in source-first homomorphism order. -/
theorem comap_comp
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v} {K : Type w}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) (psi : K →ₜ* H) (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    comap (phi.comp psi) U = comap psi (comap phi U) := by
  ext g
  rfl

end OpenNormalSubgroup

namespace ContinuousCohomology

/-- Opposite-index change of variables induced by open-normal preimage. -/
def openNormalComapFunctor
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) :
    (OpenNormalSubgroup G)ᵒᵖ ⥤ (OpenNormalSubgroup H)ᵒᵖ where
  obj U := Opposite.op (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap phi U.unop)
  map {_U _V} f :=
    (homOfLE (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_mono phi (leOfHom f.unop))).op
  map_id _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  map_comp _ _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- The open-normal preimage functor of the identity is the identity functor. -/
theorem openNormalComapFunctor_id
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] :
    openNormalComapFunctor (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) = 𝟭 _ := by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun U => ?_) ?_
  · change Opposite.op (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) U.unop) = U
    rw [OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_id, Opposite.op_unop]
  · intro U V f
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- Open-normal preimage functors compose in source-first homomorphism order. -/
theorem openNormalComapFunctor_comp
    {G : Type u} {H : Type v} {K : Type w}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H]
    [Group K] [TopologicalSpace K]
    (phi : H →ₜ* G) (psi : K →ₜ* H) :
    openNormalComapFunctor (phi.comp psi) =
      openNormalComapFunctor phi ⋙ openNormalComapFunctor psi := by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun U => ?_) ?_
  · change Opposite.op (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap (phi.comp psi) U.unop) =
      Opposite.op (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap psi
        (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap phi U.unop))
    exact congrArg Opposite.op
      (OpenNormalSubgroup.comap_comp phi psi U.unop)
  · intro U V f
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

end ContinuousCohomology

end

public import Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Connected
public import Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Regular

/-!
# Total disconnectedness of closed coset quotients

If `H` is a closed subgroup of a compact totally disconnected topological
group `G`, then the left-coset quotient `G/H` is totally disconnected.  No
normality hypothesis is needed: the proof separates two cosets by mapping
to the discrete coset quotient by an auxiliary open subgroup.

The result is theorem-valued and installs no global instance.  It is a
topological precursor for continuous-section theorems; this file constructs
no section and makes no Shapiro, Hochschild--Serre, residue, or norm-residue
claim.

## Main declaration

* `QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace_of_isClosed`

## Reference

The motivating closed-coset section theorem is J.-P. Serre,
*Galois Cohomology*, Chapter I, Section 1, Proposition 1.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Pointwise

open Set Topology

namespace QuotientGroup

universe u

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
variable [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]

/-- The continuous map from left `H`-cosets to left `P`-cosets induced by
an inclusion `H ≤ P`. -/
private def cosetProjection {H P : Subgroup G} (h : H ≤ P) :
    C(G ⧸ H, G ⧸ P) :=
  ⟨Quotient.map' id fun _ _ hab =>
      QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
        (h (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp hab)),
    continuous_id.quotient_map' fun _ _ hab =>
      QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
        (h (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp hab))⟩

/-- A left-coset quotient of a compact totally disconnected topological
group by any closed subgroup is totally disconnected.  This theorem does
not install a global instance and does not require the subgroup to be
normal. -/
theorem totallyDisconnectedSpace_of_isClosed
    (H : Subgroup G) [IsClosed (H : Set G)] :
    TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ H) := by
  have hsep : TotallySeparatedSpace (G ⧸ H) :=
    totallySeparatedSpace_iff_exists_isClopen.mpr fun q r hqr => by
      revert hqr
      refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ q r ?_
      intro g h hqr
      have hd : g⁻¹ * h ∉ H := by
        intro hd
        exact hqr (Quotient.sound'
          (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr hd))
      let U : Set G := ((g⁻¹ * h) • (H : Set G))ᶜ
      have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
        exact ((Homeomorph.mulLeft (g⁻¹ * h)).isClosedMap _
          (show IsClosed (H : Set G) from inferInstance)).isOpen_compl
      have h1U : (1 : G) ∈ U := by
        refine Set.mem_compl ?_
        rintro ⟨n, hn, hdn⟩
        have : g⁻¹ * h = n⁻¹ := by
          simpa [eq_comm] using (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hdn)
        exact hd (this ▸ inv_mem_iff.mpr hn)
      obtain ⟨M, hMU⟩ :=
        ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one
          hUopen h1U
      let P : Subgroup G := M.toSubgroup ⊔ H
      have hPopen : IsOpen (P : Set G) :=
        Subgroup.isOpen_mono le_sup_left M.isOpen
      have hdP : g⁻¹ * h ∉ P := by
        intro hmem
        rcases Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_left.mp hmem with
          ⟨m, hm, n, hn, hmn⟩
        rw [← eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq] at hmn
        exact hMU (hmn ▸ hm)
          (mem_leftCoset (g⁻¹ * h) (inv_mem_iff.mpr hn))
      let f : C(G ⧸ H, G ⧸ P) := cosetProjection le_sup_right
      let _ : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ P) :=
        QuotientGroup.discreteTopology hPopen
      let C : Set (G ⧸ H) := f ⁻¹' {f (QuotientGroup.mk g)}
      refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous,
          (isOpen_discrete {f (QuotientGroup.mk g)}).preimage f.continuous⟩
      · simp [C]
      · change f (QuotientGroup.mk h) ≠ f (QuotientGroup.mk g)
        intro heq
        apply hdP
        have hmem : h⁻¹ * g ∈ P := QuotientGroup.eq.mp heq
        simpa [mul_inv_rev] using P.inv_mem hmem
  let _ : TotallySeparatedSpace (G ⧸ H) := hsep
  infer_instance

end QuotientGroup

end

/-!
# Intersections of closed subgroups as limits of coset spaces

For a nonempty directed antitone family of closed subgroups of a compact
topological group, the left-coset space by their infimum is the
inverse limit of the individual coset spaces.  No subgroup normality or
total-disconnectedness assumption is used.

The comparison with the chosen `TopCat` limit is proved bijective by a
compact directed-intersection argument and hence is a homeomorphism.  The
comparison, its fiber construction, and the homeomorphism remain private.

## Main declarations

* `QuotientGroup.antitoneCosetSystem`
* `QuotientGroup.iInfCosetCone`
* `QuotientGroup.iInfCosetCone_π_app`
* `QuotientGroup.iInfCosetConeIsLimit`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Set Topology

namespace QuotientGroup

universe u

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
variable {ι : Type u} [Preorder ι]

/-- The inverse system of left-coset spaces associated to an antitone
family of subgroups.  An arrow `op k ⟶ op i` maps `G / S k` to
`G / S i`. -/
def antitoneCosetSystem (S : ι → Subgroup G) (hS : Antitone S) :
    ιᵒᵖ ⥤ TopCat.{u} where
  obj i := TopCat.of (G ⧸ S i.unop)
  map {i j} f := TopCat.ofHom <|
    cosetProjection (hS (leOfHom f.unop))
  map_id i := by
    ext q
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
    rfl
  map_comp f g := by
    ext q
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
    rfl

/-- The canonical cone from the coset space by the subgroup infimum to the
antitone coset system. -/
def iInfCosetCone (S : ι → Subgroup G) (hS : Antitone S) :
    Cone (antitoneCosetSystem S hS) where
  pt := TopCat.of (G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i))
  π :=
    { app := fun i => TopCat.ofHom <|
        cosetProjection (iInf_le S i.unop)
      naturality := fun i j f => by
        ext q
        obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
        rfl }

/-- A component of the canonical intersection cone is the corresponding
nested coset projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem iInfCosetCone_π_app
    (S : ι → Subgroup G) (hS : Antitone S) (i : ιᵒᵖ) :
    (iInfCosetCone S hS).π.app i =
      TopCat.ofHom (cosetProjection (iInf_le S i.unop)) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical cone from the quotient by an infimum of a nonempty
directed antitone family of closed subgroups is limiting in `TopCat`. -/
noncomputable def iInfCosetConeIsLimit
    [IsDirectedOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    (S : ι → Subgroup G) (hS : Antitone S)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (S i : Set G)) :
    IsLimit (iInfCosetCone S hS) := by
  let comparison : TopCat.of (G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i)) ⟶
      (TopCat.limitCone.{u, u, u} (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)).pt :=
    (TopCat.limitConeIsLimit.{u, u, u}
      (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)).lift (iInfCosetCone S hS)
  have comparison_apply
      (q : G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i)) (i : ιᵒᵖ) :
      (comparison q).1 i =
        cosetProjection (iInf_le S i.unop) q :=
    rfl
  have hinjective : Function.Injective comparison := by
    intro q r hqr
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective r
    apply QuotientGroup.eq.mpr
    rw [Subgroup.mem_iInf]
    intro i
    apply QuotientGroup.eq.mp
    have hi := congrArg (fun z => z.1 (Opposite.op i)) hqr
    have hg := comparison_apply
      (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i)) (Opposite.op i)
    have hh := comparison_apply
      (QuotientGroup.mk h : G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i)) (Opposite.op i)
    rw [hg, hh] at hi
    change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ S i) = QuotientGroup.mk h at hi
    exact hi
  have hsurjective : Function.Surjective comparison := by
    let _ (i : ι) : IsClosed (S i : Set G) := hclosed i
    intro z
    let A : ι → Set G := fun i =>
      QuotientGroup.mk ⁻¹' {z.1 (Opposite.op i)}
    have zcompat (i k : ι) (hik : i ≤ k) :
        cosetProjection (hS hik) (z.1 (Opposite.op k)) =
          z.1 (Opposite.op i) := by
      let f : (Opposite.op k : ιᵒᵖ) ⟶ Opposite.op i :=
        (homOfLE hik).op
      have hz := z.2 f
      change cosetProjection (hS hik) (z.1 (Opposite.op k)) =
        z.1 (Opposite.op i) at hz
      exact hz
    have hA_nonempty : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective (z.1 (Opposite.op i))
      exact ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hA_closed : ∀ i, IsClosed (A i) := by
      intro i
      let _ : IsClosed (S i : Set G) := hclosed i
      let _ : T2Space (G ⧸ S i) := QuotientGroup.instT2Space
      exact IsClosed.preimage continuous_quotient_mk' isClosed_singleton
    have hA_directed : Directed (· ⊇ ·) A := by
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨k, hik, hjk⟩ := exists_ge_ge i j
      refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro g hg
        change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ S k) =
          z.1 (Opposite.op k) at hg
        change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ S i) =
          z.1 (Opposite.op i)
        rw [← zcompat i k hik, ← hg]
        rfl
      · intro g hg
        change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ S k) =
          z.1 (Opposite.op k) at hg
        change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ S j) =
          z.1 (Opposite.op j)
        rw [← zcompat j k hjk, ← hg]
        rfl
    have hA_compact : ∀ i, IsCompact (A i) :=
      fun i => (hA_closed i).isCompact
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
      IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
        A hA_directed hA_nonempty hA_compact hA_closed
    refine ⟨(QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ (⨅ i, S i)), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    rw [comparison_apply]
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hg i.unop)
  have hhome : IsHomeomorph comparison := by
    let _ (i : ι) : IsClosed (S i : Set G) := hclosed i
    let _ (i : ιᵒᵖ) : T2Space ((antitoneCosetSystem S hS).obj i) :=
      QuotientGroup.instT2Space
    let _ : T2Space (∀ i : ιᵒᵖ, (antitoneCosetSystem S hS).obj i) :=
      Pi.t2Space
    let _ : T2Space
        {x : ∀ i : ιᵒᵖ, (antitoneCosetSystem S hS).obj i |
          ∀ {i j} (f : i ⟶ j),
            (antitoneCosetSystem S hS).map f (x i) = x j} :=
      inferInstance
    let _ : T2Space
        (TopCat.limitCone.{u, u, u} (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)).pt := by
      change T2Space
        {x : ∀ i : ιᵒᵖ, (antitoneCosetSystem S hS).obj i |
          ∀ {i j} (f : i ⟶ j),
            (antitoneCosetSystem S hS).map f (x i) = x j}
      infer_instance
    rw [isHomeomorph_iff_continuous_bijective]
    exact ⟨comparison.hom.continuous, hinjective, hsurjective⟩
  let homeo := IsHomeomorph.homeomorph
    comparison hhome
  let e : iInfCosetCone S hS ≅
      TopCat.limitCone.{u, u, u} (antitoneCosetSystem S hS) :=
    Cone.ext (TopCat.isoOfHomeo homeo) (fun i => by
      change (iInfCosetCone S hS).π.app i =
        comparison ≫
          (TopCat.limitCone.{u, u, u}
            (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)).π.app i
      exact ((TopCat.limitConeIsLimit.{u, u, u}
        (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)).fac (iInfCosetCone S hS) i).symm)
  exact IsLimit.ofIsoLimit
    (TopCat.limitConeIsLimit.{u, u, u}
      (antitoneCosetSystem S hS)) e.symm

end QuotientGroup

end

import Mathlib.Tactic.Group

/-!
# Continuous sections of finite-index nested coset projections

Let `K ≤ H` be closed subgroups of a profinite group, with `K` of finite
relative index in `H`.  The canonical continuous map from left `K`-cosets
to left `H`-cosets is a surjective local homeomorphism and therefore has a
continuous set-theoretic section.

Neither subgroup is assumed normal.  The section is existential and is not
claimed to be homomorphic, canonical, or natural.  This is only the
finite-index case; no inverse-limit or general closed-subgroup section is
constructed.

## Main declarations

* `QuotientGroup.cosetProjection`
* `QuotientGroup.cosetProjection_mk`
* `QuotientGroup.exists_continuous_section_of_isFiniteRelIndex`

## Reference

This is the finite-index leaf in the proof of J.-P. Serre,
*Galois Cohomology*, Chapter I, Section 1, Proposition 1.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set Topology
open scoped Pointwise

namespace QuotientGroup

universe u

/-- The continuous projection from left `K`-cosets to left `H`-cosets
induced by an inclusion `K ≤ H`.  No normality is required. -/
def cosetProjection
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    {K H : Subgroup G} (h : K ≤ H) : C(G ⧸ K, G ⧸ H) :=
  ⟨Quotient.map' id fun _ _ hab =>
      QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
        (h (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp hab)),
    continuous_id.quotient_map' fun _ _ hab =>
      QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mpr
        (h (QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp hab))⟩

/-- The nested coset projection sends the class of a representative to its
class modulo the larger subgroup. -/
@[simp]
theorem cosetProjection_mk
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    {K H : Subgroup G} (h : K ≤ H) (g : G) :
    cosetProjection h (QuotientGroup.mk g) = QuotientGroup.mk g :=
  rfl

private theorem cosetProjection_surjective
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    {K H : Subgroup G} (h : K ≤ H) :
    Function.Surjective (cosetProjection h) := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
  exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk g, rfl⟩

private theorem cosetProjection_isOpenMap
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [SeparatelyContinuousMul G]
    {K H : Subgroup G} (h : K ≤ H) :
    IsOpenMap (cosetProjection h) := by
  intro O hO
  have hpre : IsOpen (QuotientGroup.mk ⁻¹' O) :=
    QuotientGroup.continuous_mk.isOpen_preimage O hO
  have himage : IsOpen
      (QuotientGroup.mk '' (QuotientGroup.mk ⁻¹' O) : Set (G ⧸ H)) :=
    QuotientGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.isOpenMap _ hpre
  convert himage using 1
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective z
    exact ⟨g, hz, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk g, hg, rfl⟩

private theorem cosetProjection_isLocalHomeomorph_of_inf_le
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {K H : Subgroup G} (hKH : K ≤ H)
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (hUK : U.toSubgroup ⊓ H ≤ K) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph (cosetProjection hKH) := by
  rw [isLocalHomeomorph_iff_isOpenEmbedding_restrict]
  intro z
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective z
  let V : Set (G ⧸ K) :=
    QuotientGroup.mk '' (g • (U.toSubgroup : Set G))
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    QuotientGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.isOpenMap _
      (U.isOpen.leftCoset g)
  have hgV : QuotientGroup.mk g ∈ V := by
    refine ⟨g, ?_, rfl⟩
    simpa using mem_leftCoset g U.one_mem
  refine ⟨V, hVopen.mem_nhds hgV, ?_⟩
  apply Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap
  · exact (cosetProjection hKH).continuous.continuousOn.domRestrict
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hab
    rcases ha with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply QuotientGroup.eq.mpr
    apply hUK
    constructor
    · have hxU : g⁻¹ * x ∈ U := (mem_leftCoset_iff g).mp hx
      have hyU : g⁻¹ * y ∈ U := (mem_leftCoset_iff g).mp hy
      have hmul := U.mul_mem (U.inv_mem hxU) hyU
      have heq : (g⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * y) = x⁻¹ * y := by group
      rw [heq] at hmul
      exact hmul
    · apply QuotientGroup.eq.mp
      change cosetProjection hKH (QuotientGroup.mk x) =
        cosetProjection hKH (QuotientGroup.mk y) at hab
      exact hab
  · exact (cosetProjection_isOpenMap hKH).domRestrict hVopen

/-- If `K` has finite relative index in the closed subgroup `H` of a
profinite group, some ambient open normal subgroup meets `H` inside `K`. -/
theorem exists_openNormal_inf_le_of_isFiniteRelIndex
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (K H : Subgroup G)
    [IsClosed (K : Set G)] [K.IsFiniteRelIndex H] :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, U.toSubgroup ⊓ H ≤ K := by
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      ((K.subgroupOf H : Subgroup H) : Set H) := by
    exact (show IsClosed (H.subtype ⁻¹' (K : Set G)) from
      (show IsClosed (K : Set G) from inferInstance).preimage
        continuous_subtype_val)
  have hopen : IsOpen ((K.subgroupOf H : Subgroup H) : Set H) :=
    Subgroup.isOpen_of_isClosed_of_finiteIndex (K.subgroupOf H) hclosed
  obtain ⟨O, hOopen, hOeq⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.mp hopen
  have h1O : (1 : G) ∈ O := by
    have h1K : (1 : H) ∈ K.subgroupOf H := (K.subgroupOf H).one_mem
    have h1pre : (1 : H) ∈ H.subtype ⁻¹' O := hOeq.symm ▸ h1K
    exact h1pre
  obtain ⟨U, hUO⟩ :=
    ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one
      hOopen h1O
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  have hgO : g ∈ O := hUO hg.1
  have hgKsub : (⟨g, hg.2⟩ : H) ∈ K.subgroupOf H := by
    change (⟨g, hg.2⟩ : H) ∈ (K.subgroupOf H : Set H)
    rw [← hOeq]
    exact hgO
  exact hgKsub

/-- An open normal subgroup of an open subgroup contains the image of some
ambient open normal subgroup.  The ambient subgroup is therefore contained
in the open subgroup as well. -/
theorem exists_openNormal_le_map_openNormal
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (H : OpenSubgroup G) (V : OpenNormalSubgroup H) :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G,
      U.toSubgroup ≤ V.toSubgroup.map H.toSubgroup.subtype := by
  let K : Subgroup G := V.toSubgroup.map H.toSubgroup.subtype
  have hKopen : IsOpen (K : Set G) := by
    change IsOpen (H.toSubgroup.subtype '' (V : Set H))
    exact H.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val _ V.isOpen
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    ProfiniteGrp.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one
      hKopen K.one_mem
  exact ⟨U, hU⟩

/-- For closed nested subgroups of a profinite group, finite relative index
gives a continuous set-theoretic section of the nested coset projection. -/
theorem exists_continuous_section_of_isFiniteRelIndex
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (K H : Subgroup G) (hKH : K ≤ H)
    [IsClosed (K : Set G)] [IsClosed (H : Set G)]
    [K.IsFiniteRelIndex H] :
    ∃ s : C(G ⧸ H, G ⧸ K),
      Function.RightInverse s (cosetProjection hKH) := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_openNormal_inf_le_of_isFiniteRelIndex K H
  let _ : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (G ⧸ H) :=
    QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace_of_isClosed H
  exact
    (cosetProjection_isLocalHomeomorph_of_inf_le hKH U hU)
      |>.exists_continuous_rightInverse_of_profinite
        (cosetProjection_surjective hKH)

end QuotientGroup

end

/-!
# Continuous sections of closed normal profinite quotients

A closed normal subgroup of a profinite group has a continuous
set-theoretic quotient section.  This is the `K = ⊥` specialization of
Serre's closed-coset section theorem, transported along the canonical
homeomorphism `G / ⊥ ≃ₜ G`.

The section is neither homomorphic, canonical, nor natural.  The
quotient-bottom bridge is proof-local and no splitting instance is
introduced.

## Main declaration

* `QuotientGroup.exists_continuous_section_of_profinite`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set Topology

namespace QuotientGroup

universe u

private noncomputable def quotientBotHomeomorph
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] :
    (G ⧸ (⊥ : Subgroup G)) ≃ₜ G where
  toEquiv := QuotientGroup.quotientBot.toEquiv
  continuous_toFun := continuous_quot_lift _ continuous_id
  continuous_invFun := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk

@[simp]
private theorem quotientBotHomeomorph_mk
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] (g : G) :
    quotientBotHomeomorph G (QuotientGroup.mk g) = g :=
  rfl

private theorem quotientMk_comp_quotientBotHomeomorph
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (q : G ⧸ (⊥ : Subgroup G)) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' N (quotientBotHomeomorph G q) =
      QuotientGroup.cosetProjection
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ N) q := by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
  rfl

/-- A closed normal subgroup of a profinite group has a continuous
set-theoretic section of its quotient map. -/
theorem exists_continuous_section_of_profinite
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] [IsClosed (N : Set G)] :
    ∃ s : C(G ⧸ N, G),
      Function.RightInverse s (QuotientGroup.mk' N) := by
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_section_of_closedSubgroup_le
      (⊥ : Subgroup G) N bot_le
  let e : C(G ⧸ (⊥ : Subgroup G), G) :=
    ⟨quotientBotHomeomorph G, (quotientBotHomeomorph G).continuous⟩
  let s : C(G ⧸ N, G) := e.comp s₀
  refine ⟨s, fun q => ?_⟩
  dsimp only [s, e, ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
  change QuotientGroup.mk' N (quotientBotHomeomorph G (s₀ q)) = q
  rw [quotientMk_comp_quotientBotHomeomorph]
  exact hs₀ q

end QuotientGroup

end

For closed subgroups `K ≤ H` of a profinite group `G`, the canonical
projection from left `K`-cosets to left `H`-cosets admits a continuous
set-theoretic section.

The proof orders compatible sections over intermediate closed subgroups by
reverse inclusion.  Nonempty chains are bounded using the canonical limit
of coset spaces by subgroup intersections.  A maximal approximation is
forced down to `K` by intersecting with an open subgroup and applying the
finite-relative-index section theorem.

No subgroup normality is required.  The section is neither homomorphic,
canonical, nor natural, and no section instance is installed.

## Main declaration

* `QuotientGroup.exists_continuous_section_of_closedSubgroup_le`

## Reference

J.-P. Serre, *Galois Cohomology*, Chapter I, Section 1, Proposition 1.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Set Topology

namespace QuotientGroup

universe u

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]

@[simp]
private theorem cosetProjection_id (K : Subgroup G) :
    cosetProjection (show K ≤ K from le_rfl) =
      ContinuousMap.id (G ⧸ K) := by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
  rfl

@[simp]
private theorem cosetProjection_comp
    {K H L : Subgroup G} (hKH : K ≤ H) (hHL : H ≤ L) :
    (cosetProjection hHL).comp (cosetProjection hKH) =
      cosetProjection (hKH.trans hHL) := by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
  rfl

private structure SectionApproximation (K H : Subgroup G) where
  subgroup : Subgroup G
  lower : K ≤ subgroup
  upper : subgroup ≤ H
  closed : IsClosed (subgroup : Set G)
  sec : C(G ⧸ H, G ⧸ subgroup)
  rightInverse : Function.RightInverse sec (cosetProjection upper)

namespace SectionApproximation

variable {K H : Subgroup G}

private def Refines (A B : SectionApproximation K H) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : B.subgroup ≤ A.subgroup,
    (cosetProjection h).comp B.sec = A.sec

private instance : LE (SectionApproximation K H) := ⟨Refines⟩

private instance : Preorder (SectionApproximation K H) where
  le_refl A := by
    refine ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [cosetProjection_id]
    ext x
    rfl
  le_trans A B C hAB hBC := by
    obtain ⟨hBA, hsAB⟩ := hAB
    obtain ⟨hCB, hsBC⟩ := hBC
    refine ⟨hCB.trans hBA, ?_⟩
    rw [← cosetProjection_comp hCB hBA]
    rw [ContinuousMap.comp_assoc, hsBC, hsAB]

private theorem ext {A B : SectionApproximation K H}
    (hsub : A.subgroup = B.subgroup)
    (hsec : HEq A.sec B.sec) : A = B := by
  cases A
  cases B
  cases hsub
  cases hsec
  rfl

private instance : PartialOrder (SectionApproximation K H) where
  le_antisymm A B hAB hBA := by
    obtain ⟨hBsubA, hsecAB⟩ := hAB
    obtain ⟨hAsubB, _hsecBA⟩ := hBA
    have hsub : A.subgroup = B.subgroup := le_antisymm hAsubB hBsubA
    apply ext hsub
    cases A
    cases B
    dsimp at hsub ⊢
    subst hsub
    simp only [cosetProjection_id, ContinuousMap.id_comp] at hsecAB
    exact heq_of_eq hsecAB.symm

end SectionApproximation

variable {K H : Subgroup G}

private def chainSubgroups (c : Set (SectionApproximation K H)) :
    c → Subgroup G := fun A => A.1.subgroup

private theorem chainSubgroups_antitone
    (c : Set (SectionApproximation K H)) :
    Antitone (chainSubgroups c) := by
  intro A B hAB
  exact hAB.choose

private def chainSectionCone
    (c : Set (SectionApproximation K H)) :
    Cone (antitoneCosetSystem (chainSubgroups c)
      (chainSubgroups_antitone c)) where
  pt := TopCat.of (G ⧸ H)
  π :=
    { app := fun A => TopCat.ofHom A.unop.1.sec
      naturality := fun A B f => by
        have hBA : B.unop.1 ≤ A.unop.1 := leOfHom f.unop
        obtain ⟨_hsub, hsec⟩ := hBA
        ext q
        exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hsec q).symm }

private theorem exists_upperBound_of_nonempty_chain
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    {c : Set (SectionApproximation K H)}
    (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c) (hne : c.Nonempty) :
    ∃ ub : SectionApproximation K H, ∀ A ∈ c, A ≤ ub := by
  let _ : Nonempty c := hne.to_subtype
  let _ : IsDirectedOrder c := ⟨hc.directedOn.directed_val⟩
  let S : c → Subgroup G := chainSubgroups c
  let hS : Antitone S := chainSubgroups_antitone c
  let hclosed : ∀ A : c, IsClosed (S A : Set G) := fun A => A.1.closed
  let hlim : IsLimit (iInfCosetCone S hS) :=
    iInfCosetConeIsLimit S hS hclosed
  let C : Cone (antitoneCosetSystem S hS) := chainSectionCone c
  let lift : TopCat.of (G ⧸ H) ⟶ TopCat.of (G ⧸ (⨅ A, S A)) :=
    hlim.lift C
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ := hne
  let A0c : c := ⟨A0, hA0⟩
  have hlower : K ≤ ⨅ A, S A := by
    rw [le_iInf_iff]
    intro A
    exact A.1.lower
  have hupper : (⨅ A, S A) ≤ H :=
    (iInf_le S A0c).trans A0c.1.upper
  have hclosedInf : IsClosed ((⨅ A, S A : Subgroup G) : Set G) := by
    rw [Subgroup.coe_iInf]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun A => hclosed A
  have hright : Function.RightInverse lift.hom
      (cosetProjection hupper) := by
    intro q
    have hfac := hlim.fac C (Opposite.op A0c)
    have hfacq := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hfac q
    change cosetProjection (iInf_le S A0c) (lift q) =
      A0c.1.sec q at hfacq
    change cosetProjection hupper (lift q) = q
    have hcomp := cosetProjection_comp
      (iInf_le S A0c) A0c.1.upper
    have hcompq := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp (lift q)
    calc
      cosetProjection hupper (lift q) =
          cosetProjection A0c.1.upper
            (cosetProjection (iInf_le S A0c) (lift q)) :=
        hcompq.symm
      _ = cosetProjection A0c.1.upper (A0c.1.sec q) :=
        congrArg _ hfacq
      _ = q := A0c.1.rightInverse q
  let ub : SectionApproximation K H :=
    { subgroup := ⨅ A, S A
      lower := hlower
      upper := hupper
      closed := hclosedInf
      sec := lift.hom
      rightInverse := hright }
  refine ⟨ub, fun A hA => ?_⟩
  let Ac : c := ⟨A, hA⟩
  refine ⟨iInf_le S Ac, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro q
  have hfac := hlim.fac C (Opposite.op Ac)
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hfac q

private def initialApproximation
    (hKH : K ≤ H) (hHclosed : IsClosed (H : Set G)) :
    SectionApproximation K H where
  subgroup := H
  lower := hKH
  upper := le_rfl
  closed := hHclosed
  sec := ContinuousMap.id (G ⧸ H)
  rightInverse := by
    intro q
    rw [cosetProjection_id]
    rfl

/-- For closed subgroups `K ≤ H` of a profinite group, the canonical
projection `G / K → G / H` admits a continuous set-theoretic section. -/
theorem exists_continuous_section_of_closedSubgroup_le
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (K H : Subgroup G) (hKH : K ≤ H)
    [hKclosed : IsClosed (K : Set G)]
    [hHclosed : IsClosed (H : Set G)] :
    ∃ s : C(G ⧸ H, G ⧸ K),
      Function.RightInverse s (cosetProjection hKH) := by
  let _ : Nonempty (SectionApproximation K H) :=
    ⟨initialApproximation hKH hHclosed⟩
  have hzorn : ∃ M : SectionApproximation K H, IsMax M :=
    zorn_le_nonempty (fun (c : Set (SectionApproximation K H)) hc hne =>
      exists_upperBound_of_nonempty_chain (G := G) (K := K) (H := H)
        hc hne)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hzorn
  have hMK : M.subgroup = K := by
    apply le_antisymm
    swap
    · exact M.lower
    by_contra hnot
    have hne : K ≠ M.subgroup := fun heq => hnot (by rw [← heq])
    have hstrict : K < M.subgroup := lt_of_le_of_ne M.lower hne
    obtain ⟨x, hxM, hxK⟩ := IsConcreteLE.exists_of_lt hstrict
    let Kc : ClosedSubgroup G := ⟨K, hKclosed⟩
    have hKsInf := ProfiniteGrp.closedSubgroup_eq_sInf_open Kc
    have hexists : ∃ L : Subgroup G,
        (IsOpen (L : Set G) ∧ K ≤ L) ∧ x ∉ L := by
      by_contra hn
      push Not at hn
      have hxInf :
          x ∈ sInf {L : Subgroup G | IsOpen (L : Set G) ∧ K ≤ L} :=
        Subgroup.mem_sInf.mpr fun L hL => hn L hL
      have hxK' : x ∈ K := by
        have hKsInf' : K =
            sInf {L : Subgroup G | IsOpen (L : Set G) ∧ K ≤ L} := by
          simpa [Kc] using hKsInf
        rw [hKsInf']
        exact hxInf
      exact hxK hxK'
    obtain ⟨L, ⟨hLopen, hKL⟩, hxL⟩ := hexists
    let T : Subgroup G := M.subgroup ⊓ L
    have hKT : K ≤ T := le_inf M.lower hKL
    have hTS : T ≤ M.subgroup := inf_le_left
    have hTclosed : IsClosed (T : Set G) :=
      M.closed.inter (Subgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen L hLopen)
    have hTne : T ≠ M.subgroup := by
      intro heq
      have hxT : x ∈ T := heq ▸ hxM
      exact hxL hxT.2
    have hTfinite : T.IsFiniteRelIndex M.subgroup := by
      rw [Subgroup.isFiniteRelIndex_iff_finiteIndex]
      let _ : CompactSpace M.subgroup :=
        isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp M.closed.isCompact
      have hopen : IsOpen
          ((T.subgroupOf M.subgroup : Subgroup M.subgroup) :
            Set M.subgroup) := by
        change IsOpen (M.subgroup.subtype ⁻¹' (T : Set G))
        have heqpre : M.subgroup.subtype ⁻¹' (T : Set G) =
            M.subgroup.subtype ⁻¹' (L : Set G) := by
          ext y
          simp [T]
        rw [heqpre]
        exact hLopen.preimage continuous_subtype_val
      let _ : Finite
          (M.subgroup ⧸ (T.subgroupOf M.subgroup)) :=
        (T.subgroupOf M.subgroup).quotient_finite_of_isOpen hopen
      exact Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient
    let _ : IsClosed (T : Set G) := hTclosed
    let _ : IsClosed (M.subgroup : Set G) := M.closed
    let _ : T.IsFiniteRelIndex M.subgroup := hTfinite
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ :=
      exists_continuous_section_of_isFiniteRelIndex T M.subgroup hTS
    let R : SectionApproximation K H :=
      { subgroup := T
        lower := hKT
        upper := hTS.trans M.upper
        closed := hTclosed
        sec := r.comp M.sec
        rightInverse := by
          intro q
          have hcomp := cosetProjection_comp hTS M.upper
          have hcompq := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp (r (M.sec q))
          calc
            cosetProjection (hTS.trans M.upper) (r (M.sec q)) =
                cosetProjection M.upper
                  (cosetProjection hTS (r (M.sec q))) :=
              hcompq.symm
            _ = cosetProjection M.upper (M.sec q) :=
              congrArg _ (hr (M.sec q))
            _ = q := M.rightInverse q }
    have hMR : M ≤ R := by
      refine ⟨hTS, ?_⟩
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro q
      exact hr (M.sec q)
    have hRM := hM hMR
    have hMleT : M.subgroup ≤ T := hRM.choose
    exact hTne (le_antisymm hTS hMleT)
  cases M with
  | mk S lower upper closed sec rightInverse =>
      dsimp at hMK
      subst S
      exact ⟨sec, rightInverse⟩

end QuotientGroup

end

/-!
# Continuity of right transversals of open subgroups

The existing right-coset representative is locally constant when the subgroup is open.
Both components of the existing complement equivalence are then continuous.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Subgroup.IsComplement

universe u

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  {H : Subgroup G} {T : Set G}

/-- The existing right-coset representative of an open subgroup is locally constant. -/
theorem isLocallyConstant_toRightFun (hT : IsComplement (H : Set G) T)
    (hOpen : IsOpen (H : Set G)) : IsLocallyConstant hT.toRightFun := by
  let : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ H) := QuotientGroup.discreteTopology_iff.mpr hOpen
  have hq : IsLocallyConstant (fun g : G => (QuotientGroup.mk g⁻¹ : G ⧸ H)) :=
    (IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous _).mpr
      (QuotientGroup.continuous_mk.comp continuous_inv)
  have hc := hq.comp
    (hT.rightQuotientEquiv ∘ (QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel H).symm)
  have heq (g : G) :
      (QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel H).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk g⁻¹ : G ⧸ H) = Quotient.mk'' g := by
    change Quotient.mk'' (g⁻¹)⁻¹ = Quotient.mk'' g
    rw [inv_inv]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, heq, toRightFun] using hc

/-- The transversal component of the existing complement equivalence is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_equiv_snd (hT : IsComplement (H : Set G) T)
    (hOpen : IsOpen (H : Set G)) : Continuous (fun g : G => (hT.equiv g).2) := by
  have heq : hT.toRightFun = fun g => (hT.equiv g).2 := by
    funext g
    apply hT.rightQuotientEquiv.symm.injective
    change Quotient.mk'' (hT.toRightFun g : G) = Quotient.mk'' ((hT.equiv g).2 : G)
    change Quotient.mk'' (hT.rightQuotientEquiv (Quotient.mk'' g) : G) =
      Quotient.mk'' ((hT.equiv g).2 : G)
    rw [mk''_rightQuotientEquiv]
    exact Quotient.sound' (by
      simpa only [QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply, RightCosetEquivalence,
        rightCoset_eq_iff] using hT.rightCosetEquivalence_equiv_snd g)
  rw [← heq]
  exact (hT.isLocallyConstant_toRightFun hOpen).continuous

/-- The subgroup component of the existing complement equivalence is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_equiv_fst (hT : IsComplement (H : Set G) T)
    (hOpen : IsOpen (H : Set G)) : Continuous (fun g : G => (hT.equiv g).1) := by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  have hs := (hT.continuous_equiv_snd hOpen).subtype_val
  have hmul : Continuous (fun g : G => g * ((hT.equiv g).2 : G)⁻¹) :=
    continuous_id.mul hs.inv
  simpa only [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv] using hmul

end Subgroup.IsComplement

namespace IsUniformAddGroup

/-- A uniform additive group with a complete neighborhood of zero is complete. -/
theorem completeSpace_of_isComplete_mem_nhds_zero
    {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] [UniformSpace G] [IsUniformAddGroup G]
    {S : Set G} (hS : IsComplete S) (hS0 : S ∈ 𝓝 (0 : G)) :
    CompleteSpace G where
  complete {f} hf := by
    have : f.NeBot := hf.1
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : G, ∀ᶠ y in f, y - x ∈ S := by
      have h := (IsUniformAddGroup.cauchy_iff_tendsto_swapped f).mp hf
      exact (h.2.eventually_mem hS0).curry.exists
    have htranslated : IsComplete ((fun y : G => y + x) '' S) :=
      (isUniformEmbedding_translate_add x).isComplete_iff.mpr hS
    obtain ⟨l, _, hl⟩ := htranslated f hf (by
      apply le_principal_iff.mpr
      filter_upwards [hx] with y hy
      exact ⟨y - x, hy, sub_add_cancel y x⟩)
    exact ⟨l, hl⟩

end IsUniformAddGroup

/-!

The standard finite-Pi instances make the ambient finite-index matrix spaces
locally compact.  Closedness of the unitary locus then gives the corresponding
instances for rank-`n` complex unitary and real orthogonal groups.
-/

noncomputable section

topology. -/

    LocallyCompactSpace (unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ) := by
  exact @IsClosed.locallyCompactSpace
    (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) inferInstance
    (inferInstanceAs (LocallyCompactSpace (Fin n → Fin n → ℂ))) _
    (isClosed_unitary (R := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ))

topology. -/

    (inferInstanceAs (LocallyCompactSpace (Fin n → Fin n → ℝ))) _

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.PiLp
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.PiProd

/-!
# Rectangular matrices of continuous linear maps on PiLp

An operator-valued matrix acts by finite column summation on the existing
product-topological `PiLp 2` carrier. The row index may be arbitrary.
Coordinate recovery uses the existing single-coordinate injections and
projections; it requires neither finite indices nor continuity of addition.

The action and recovery are inverse when the column index is finite and
addition is continuous in the target. They give a bare equivalence, without
a commutative-scalar, norm, completeness or separation hypothesis.
For arbitrary row indices, the topology here is still the product topology,
not the topology of an infinite square-summable space.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

universe uR uM uN uE uF uK uG

variable {R : Type uR} [Semiring R]
variable {m : Type uM} {n : Type uN}
variable {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [AddCommGroup E] [TopologicalSpace E] [Module R E]
variable [AddCommGroup F] [TopologicalSpace F] [Module R F]

namespace Matrix

/-- A rectangular matrix of continuous linear maps acts by finite column
summation on the existing PiLp product topology. Rows need not be finite. -/
def toPiLpContinuousLinearMap [Fintype n] [ContinuousAdd F]
    (M : Matrix m n (E →L[R] F)) :
    PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : m => F) :=
  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : m => F)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i : m =>
      ∑ j : n, (M i j).comp
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (n → E) →L[R] E).comp
          (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : n => E)).toContinuousLinearMap))

/-- Evaluation of the column action at a target row. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply [Fintype n] [ContinuousAdd F]
    (M : Matrix m n (E →L[R] F)) (v : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E)) (i : m) :
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M v i = ∑ j : n, M i j (v j) := by
  change (∑ j : n, (M i j).comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (n → E) →L[R] E).comp
      (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : n => E)).toContinuousLinearMap)) v = _
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv_apply]

end Matrix

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

/-- Recover a rectangular operator matrix by injecting a source coordinate,
applying the map and projecting a target coordinate. No finiteness or
continuity of addition is required. -/
def toPiLpMatrix [DecidableEq n]
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : m => F)) :
    Matrix m n (E →L[R] F) :=
  Matrix.of fun i j =>
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (m → F) →L[R] F).comp
      (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : m => F)).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
      (T.comp
        ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : n => E)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.single R (fun _ : n => E) j)))

/-- Evaluation of a recovered coefficient on a source vector. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpMatrix_apply [DecidableEq n]
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : m => F))
    (i : m) (j : n) (x : E) :
    toPiLpMatrix T i j x = T (PiLp.single 2 j x) i :=
  rfl

/-- Recovering the coefficients of the finite-column action returns the
original operator-valued matrix. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpMatrix_toPiLpContinuousLinearMap [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [ContinuousAdd F] (M : Matrix m n (E →L[R] F)) :
    toPiLpMatrix (Matrix.toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M) = M := by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [toPiLpMatrix_apply, Matrix.toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [PiLp.single_eq_same]
  · intro k _ hk
    rw [PiLp.single_eq_of_ne 2 hk, map_zero]
  · intro hj
    exact (hj (Finset.mem_univ j)).elim

end ContinuousLinearMap

namespace Matrix

/-- Finite source-coordinate reconstruction recovers the original map from
its operator-valued matrix. -/
@[simp]
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_toPiLpMatrix [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [ContinuousAdd F]
    (T : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : m => F)) :
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix T) = T := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  let U : (n → E) →L[R] F :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (m → F) →L[R] F).comp
      (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : m => F)).toContinuousLinearMap).comp
      (T.comp
        (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 R (fun _ : n => E)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)
  change (∑ j : n,
    (U.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.single R (fun _ : n => E) j)) (v j)) =
      U (WithLp.ofLp v)
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.sum_comp_single R (fun _ : n => E) U (WithLp.ofLp v)

/-- Rectangular operator matrices and continuous linear maps on the actual
PiLp products are equivalent when source coordinates are finite. -/
def piLpContinuousLinearMapEquiv [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [ContinuousAdd F] :
    Matrix m n (E →L[R] F) ≃
      (PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : m => F)) where
  toFun := toPiLpContinuousLinearMap
  invFun := ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix
  left_inv := ContinuousLinearMap.toPiLpMatrix_toPiLpContinuousLinearMap
  right_inv := toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_toPiLpMatrix

section Composition

variable {k : Type uK}
variable {G : Type uG} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [Module R G]

/-- Rectangular composition acts in the same order as the corresponding
continuous linear maps: the right matrix acts first. -/
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_comp [Fintype n] [Fintype k]
    [ContinuousAdd F] [ContinuousAdd G]
    (M : Matrix m n (F →L[R] G)) (N : Matrix n k (E →L[R] F)) :
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (of fun i l => ∑ j : n, (M i j).comp (N j l)) =
      (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M).comp (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap N) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (of fun i l => ∑ j : n, (M i j).comp (N j l)) v i =
      toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M (toPiLpContinuousLinearMap N v) i
  simp only [toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply, of_apply, _root_.sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

end Composition

section Square

open scoped Matrix

/-- The square operator-matrix action preserves actual ordered matrix
multiplication, where operator multiplication is composition. -/
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_mul [Fintype n] [ContinuousAdd E]
    (M N : Matrix n n (E →L[R] E)) :
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (M * N) =
      toPiLpContinuousLinearMap M * toPiLpContinuousLinearMap N := by
  have hMul : (of fun i j : n => ∑ l : n, (M i l).comp (N l j)) = M * N := by
    ext i j
    simp only [of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]
  rw [← hMul, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def]
  exact toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_comp M N

/-- The action of the identity matrix is the actual identity map, including
an empty index type. -/
theorem toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_one [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [ContinuousAdd E] :
    toPiLpContinuousLinearMap (1 : Matrix n n (E →L[R] E)) =
      (1 : PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E) →L[R] PiLp 2 (fun _ : n => E)) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [toPiLpContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  change (∑ j : n, (1 : Matrix n n (E →L[R] E)) i j (v j)) = v i
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    rfl
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm hji)]
    rfl
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

end Square

end Matrix

end

  let e₀ : ℝ ≃ₜ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
    (orderIsoIooNegOneOne ℝ).toHomeomorph
  let a : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ :=

      (Homeomorph.setCongr (by

            (by norm_num) from rfl,
          affineHomeomorph_image_Ioo (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ)
            (-1 : ℝ) 1 (by positivity)]
        norm_num))
  exact e₀.trans e₁

module

public import MathlibExt.Algebra.Ring.GeneratingTuples
public import Mathlib.Data.ENat.Lattice
public import Mathlib.Data.PNat.Notation
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Ring.Basic

import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Lemmas

/-!
# Numeric topological stable rank

The algebraic generator predicates live in the lower pure-algebra module.
This module owns the exposed density bound, its positive-length monotonicity,
the numeric infimum, and basic ENat characteristics.
-/

public section

open Set

universe u

/-- Rieffel's finite bound: left-generating `n`-tuples are dense in all
`n`-tuples, with the actual finite product topology. -/
@[expose] def HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    (n : ℕ+) : Prop :=
  Dense {a : Fin n → R | IsLeftGeneratingTuple a}

/-- Density of left-generating tuples is monotone in the positive tuple
length. -/
theorem HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost.mono
    {R : Type u} [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    {m n : ℕ+} (hm : HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R m)
    (hmn : m ≤ n) : HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n := by
  have hmnNat : (m : ℕ) ≤ (n : ℕ) := hmn
  let d : ℕ := (n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)
  have hsize : (m : ℕ) + d = (n : ℕ) := Nat.add_sub_of_le hmnNat
  change Dense {a : Fin (n : ℕ) → R | IsLeftGeneratingTuple a}
  rw [← hsize]
  change Dense {a : Fin (m : ℕ) → R | IsLeftGeneratingTuple a} at hm
  let e : ((Fin (m : ℕ) → R) × (Fin d → R)) ≃ₜ
      (Fin ((m : ℕ) + d) → R) :=
    Fin.appendHomeomorph (X := R) (m : ℕ) d
  let generators : Set (Fin (m : ℕ) → R) :=
    {a | IsLeftGeneratingTuple a}
  have hprod : Dense
      (generators ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin d → R))) :=
    hm.prod dense_univ
  have hpull : Dense
      (e.symm ⁻¹' (generators ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin d → R)))) :=
    hprod.preimage e.symm.isOpenMap
  refine hpull.mono ?_
  intro x hx
  change IsLeftGeneratingTuple x
  have hxleft : IsLeftGeneratingTuple (e.symm x).1 := hx.1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hxleft
  refine ⟨e (b, fun _ => 0), ?_⟩
  rw [← e.apply_symm_apply x]
  change
    (∑ i : Fin ((m : ℕ) + d),
      Fin.append b (fun _ => 0) i *
        Fin.append (e.symm x).1 (e.symm x).2 i) = 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  exact hb

/-- Numeric topological stable rank.  Finite values are positive natural
numbers; `⊤` means no finite left-generating tuple locus is dense. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def topologicalStableRank
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ n : {n : ℕ+ // HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n},
    ((n.1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

/-- Any witnessed dense generator length is an upper bound for the numeric
topological stable rank. -/
theorem topologicalStableRank_le_natCast
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    (n : ℕ+) (hn : HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n) :
    topologicalStableRank R ≤ ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  unfold topologicalStableRank
  exact iInf_le_of_le ⟨n, hn⟩ le_rfl

/-- The numeric rank is infinite exactly when no positive finite generator
length has dense locus. -/
theorem topologicalStableRank_eq_top_iff
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] :
    topologicalStableRank R = ⊤ ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ+, ¬ HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n := by
  change
    (⨅ n : {n : ℕ+ // HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n},
      ((n.1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) = ⊤ ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro htop n hn
    let : IsEmpty {n : ℕ+ // HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n} :=
      (ENat.iInf_natCast_eq_top.mp htop)
    exact isEmptyElim (⟨n, hn⟩ : {n : ℕ+ // HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n})
  · intro hnone
    let : IsEmpty {n : ℕ+ // HasTopologicalStableRankAtMost R n} :=
      ⟨fun n => hnone n.1 n.2⟩
    exact ENat.iInf_eq_top_of_isEmpty

/-- Numeric topological stable rank cannot be zero because all candidate
lengths are positive.  This remains true when no finite length works. -/
theorem topologicalStableRank_ne_zero
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace R] :
    topologicalStableRank R ≠ 0 := by
  unfold topologicalStableRank
  intro hzero
  rw [ENat.iInf_eq_zero] at hzero
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hzero
  have hn0 : (n.1 : ℕ) = 0 := ENat.natCast_inj.mp hn
  exact (Nat.ne_of_gt n.1.pos) hn0

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.IsLocalHomeomorph
import Mathlib.Topology.Separation.DisjointCover

/-!
# Sections of local homeomorphisms over profinite spaces

A surjective local homeomorphism over a compact Hausdorff totally
disconnected space has a continuous right inverse.  The proof chooses local
inverses, refines their domains to a finite pairwise-disjoint clopen cover,
and glues the corresponding local sections.

The resulting section is merely existential: no canonical choice,
naturality, or global instance is introduced.

## Main declaration

* `IsLocalHomeomorph.exists_continuous_rightInverse_of_profinite`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set Topology

universe u v

namespace IsLocalHomeomorph

/-- A surjective local homeomorphism over a compact Hausdorff totally
disconnected space admits a continuous right inverse. -/
theorem exists_continuous_rightInverse_of_profinite
    {E : Type u} {X : Type v}
    [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace X]
    {f : E → X} (hf : IsLocalHomeomorph f)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :
    ∃ s : C(X, E), Function.RightInverse s f := by
  choose e he using hsurj
  let U : X → TopologicalSpace.Opens X := fun x =>
    ⟨(hf.localInverseAt (e x)).source,
      (hf.localInverseAt (e x)).open_source⟩
  have hU : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover U :=
    TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover.of_sets
      (fun x => (hf.localInverseAt (e x)).open_source) (by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        simpa only [he x] using
          (hf.apply_self_mem_localInverseAt_source (x := e x)))
  obtain ⟨n, W, hWdata, hWcover, hWdisj⟩ :=
    hU.exists_finite_nonempty_disjoint_clopen_cover
  choose i hi using fun j => (hWdata j).2
  have hmem (x : X) : ∃ j : Fin n, x ∈ (W j : Set X) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion] using hWcover (Set.mem_univ x)
  let pick : X → Fin n := fun x => Classical.choose (hmem x)
  have pick_mem (x : X) : x ∈ (W (pick x) : Set X) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hmem x)
  have pick_eq_of_mem (x : X) (j : Fin n)
      (hx : x ∈ (W j : Set X)) : pick x = j := by
    by_contra hne
    have hd := hWdisj hne
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1
      (show Disjoint (W (pick x) : Set X) (W j : Set X) from
        TopologicalSpace.Clopens.coe_disjoint.mpr hd)
      (pick_mem x) hx
  let s : X → E := fun x => hf.localInverseAt (e (i (pick x))) x
  have hscont : Continuous s := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro x
    let j := pick x
    have hxW : x ∈ (W j : Set X) := pick_mem x
    have hWsource : (W j : Set X) ⊆
        (hf.localInverseAt (e (i j))).source := hi j
    have hxsource : x ∈ (hf.localInverseAt (e (i j))).source :=
      hWsource hxW
    have hlocal : ContinuousAt
        (fun y => hf.localInverseAt (e (i j)) y) x :=
      (hf.localInverseAt (e (i j))).continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((hf.localInverseAt (e (i j))).open_source.mem_nhds hxsource)
    apply hlocal.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [(W j).isOpen.mem_nhds hxW] with y hy
    change hf.localInverseAt (e (i (pick y))) y =
      hf.localInverseAt (e (i j)) y
    rw [show pick y = j from pick_eq_of_mem y j hy]
  refine ⟨⟨s, hscont⟩, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let j := pick x
  have hxW : x ∈ (W j : Set X) := pick_mem x
  have hxsource : x ∈ (hf.localInverseAt (e (i j))).source :=
    hi j hxW
  change f (hf.localInverseAt (e (i j)) x) = x
  exact hf.apply_localInverseAt_of_mem hxsource

end IsLocalHomeomorph

end
